fresh_images.read: Coherent pearl-toned mechanical jellyfish on a slim central stand and low round foot. Broad thin-edged scalloped bell carries pink and blue accents. Peripheral beaded tentacles surround wavy inner ribbons. Bell shading now reads as a smooth shell instead of a coarse triangle patchwork.

Shared-framing pair clearly associates a lower bell and lower blue ring with outward-angled suspension arms, outward-flared tentacle strands and slightly higher strand ends. Fixed support/base remains stable between authored states. This establishes a depicted state relationship, not operating movement.

Large triangular tonal facets that blocked round2 are resolved. Broad continuous shading across the scalloped shell permits a smooth-bell reading. A deliberate crown-to-skirt boundary, gentle scallops and discrete pastel regions remain. Sparse tiny raster specks do not obscure or change the form.

prior_supplemental_views.observations: Opposite low-oblique views show four wavy ribbon arms, two pink and two blue; peripheral strands can be counted as four front/back pairs with distinct terminal beads and parallel bead sequences where their projections overlap. Caption gives pressed CAD height113.6mm and width102.1mm.

Thin-edged pearl-toned shell with gentle scallops and pastel pink/blue sectors. Large triangular tonal facets remain clearly visible across the sloped shell. The image does not resolve whether those facets are shading artifacts or actual geometric creases.
prior_supplemental_views.status: Historical round2 image and observation; superseded for round3 smoothness by fresh bell-detail.png.

boolean_evidence.held_object_unmistakable: The bell-over-tentacles silhouette, inner ribbons and fixed desktop pedestal consistently read as a mechanical jellyfish companion; this identification was already made in the unrevealed round2 read.
boolean_evidence.form_matches_wish: Smooth-looking thin pearl bell, gentle scallops, pastel pink/blue accents, narrow stand and long bead strands are visible; exact hidden counts use the unchanged requested supplemental evidence.
boolean_evidence.subjects_match_wish: One jellyfish-like object with eight peripheral strands and four inner ribbon arms; count evidence was acquired after reveal and is explicitly identified.
boolean_evidence.action_matches_wish: True only for static association: the right authored state visibly pairs bell lowering with ring lowering and outward tentacle flare/lift. No motion, return or wind-up performance is inferred.
boolean_evidence.relationship_matches_wish: The tentacles visibly attach below the bell to common upper linkage components surrounding the support, with four inner ribbons inside the peripheral tentacle corona.
boolean_evidence.anti_generic_signature_visible: The coherent gathered/spread pair, linked beaded tentacles and contrasting inner ribbons show a specific mechanical jellyfish concept rather than relying only on color or decoration.
boolean_evidence.signature_experience_unmistakable: True only for the intended depicted press-associated transformation: lower bell and wider tentacle skirt are unmistakably different states. Actual tactile or timed experience is unverified.
boolean_evidence.finished_product_desirable: As an image-based design judgment, the restrained pastel/pearl palette, orderly repeated beads, gentle scallops and inviting broad press surface form an appealing small mechanical desk object. This is not a physical finish or human-response test.

renderer_repair_assessment.evidence: Fresh round3 bell-detail and overall views remove the large triangular tonal patches while retaining silhouette, scallops, actual crown boundary and color sectors.
renderer_repair_assessment.provenance_boundary: Root reports unchanged geometry and face-local interpolated normals; this critic evaluates the actual resulting images and has not independently audited renderer source.
